change_from_prior_negative: One shared initiation model and explicit UNKNOWN/wrong/oracle-positive metrics removed the arm-specific initiation confound.

diagnosis: Shared initiation removed the entry-selection confound but did not differentiate continuation behavior.

The oracle-positive set remained empty because terminal KEEP was evaluator-correct from the historical state in nearly every resolvable mode and the scalar-ground-truth construction did not represent real time-varying replacement/reversal.

With zero beneficial targets, the continuation learner had no valid option-completion signal; policy comparisons are invalid until the evaluator contains nonzero economically beneficial temporal investigations.
The next revision must use evaluator-only time-varying hidden truth, score terminal actions against the state at each time, and add an oracle-prevalence parity gate before interpreting arms.
